case.title: Generic recovery request
case.variant: Existing confirmed owner-controlled test account: generic acknowledgement and recovery email receipt
case.identity: Same confirmed test email used in the current signup/sign-in tests
case.expected_acknowledgement: If your account can receive this link, check your inbox for the newest email. Wait a minute before requesting another.
case.expected_email: One recovery/reset email for the intended test account

source_scope: Existing request handler sends one Auth recovery request and displays generic feedback for non-rate errors. Message alone does not prove delivery or indistinguishability of all backend responses.
cleanup: Keep the request browser context available for the following isolated-link check. The new email link remains unopened; no password/session/device change is requested. Later steps need a separate explicit handoff.
